That morning a green bottle nudged the rocks below, catching the pale light. He climbed down, salt stinging his hands, and worked the cork free. Inside lay a strip of paper, curled and brittle. The handwriting was faint but careful: a woman thanking whoever found it, describing a garden she missed, a dog named Biscuit, a life paused by distance. No name, no return address. He read it twice, then set it on his table beside the lamp. For the first time in years the lighthouse felt less like a lonely post and more like a quiet conversation across water.", "w02": "凌晨四点，城市还沉在深蓝色的睡梦里。街灯昏黄，照着空荡的马路，偶尔有一辆出租车驶过，留下湿漉漉的轮印。早点铺的灯最先亮起，蒸笼冒出白汽，老板打着哈欠和面。远处的高楼只剩零星几扇窗透着光，像不肯闭眼的眼睛。清洁工推着车，扫帚划过地面，发出沙沙的声响。天边泛起一线微亮，鸟雀开始试探地鸣叫。这一刻的城市格外安静，仿佛在积蓄力量，等待又一个喧嚣白昼的到来。", "w03": "- Recursion is when something solves a big problem by doing a tiny piece and then asking a smaller copy of itself to do the rest.\n- Like looking in two mirrors facing each other: each reflection contains another, smaller reflection inside it.\n- It always needs a stopping rule, so it knows when to quit instead of going forever."}
